label: Late copy-phase steps of short (L=3/4) sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never on original-token or <DEL> steps, and never on the first occurrence of a token. Activity is concentrated in short sequences: for L=3 both copy steps (outputting orig(1) and orig(2)) fire with ~87% precision and carry ~61% of activation mass; strongest activations (top quartile, ~85% covered) are at L=3 step 5 (input orig(1) fed back, outputting the last token). For L=4 it fires mainly at the second-to-last step (recall_idx 2), at ~24% precision. Longer sequences give weak, sparse activations near the end of the copy (to_go <= 1), and somewhat more often when the fed-back input is f or h (in_tok f/h lift 5-6x). Magnitude is greatest for L=3 and the recall_idx=2 position; the token identity modulates firing for L>=4 but no clean token rule was found. Predicate covers ~81% of mass but precision ~0.4.
